---
name: Issue report
about: Report a bug, suggest a feature, or describe an accessibility barrier.
---

Before opening an issue, search existing issues for the same problem or suggestion.
Report security vulnerabilities privately using the [security policy](https://github.com/isthisgitlab/gurushots-auto-vote/blob/master/SECURITY.md).

## Issue type

- [ ] Bug report
- [ ] Feature request
- [ ] Accessibility barrier

## Summary

Describe the problem or suggestion and the task you want to complete.

## Environment

- App version or commit:
- Interface (desktop, CLI, Android, web, or paired remote page):
- Operating system and version:
- Device and browser/version, if relevant:
- Full or lite build:
- Real or mock mode:

## Steps to reproduce

For a bug or accessibility barrier, list the steps that show the problem.
For a feature request, write "Not applicable" and describe your use case in the summary.

## Expected behavior

Describe what you expected or what the proposed feature should do.

## Actual behavior

Describe what happens now.

## Accessibility details (optional)

If relevant, include your screen reader or other assistive technology and its version,
input method (keyboard, touch, voice, or other), zoom or text size, and theme.
See the [accessibility document](https://github.com/isthisgitlab/gurushots-auto-vote/blob/master/ACCESSIBILITY.md).

## Additional context (optional)

Include any workaround, proposed solution, or relevant logs.
Screenshots and recordings are optional; a text description is enough.
Remove passwords, tokens, pairing links, and personal data before posting text or attachments.
